# Test fixtures

Saved Bastions and a stand-in tool used by the tests. Nothing here is loaded by the suite itself.

- `bastion-before-overhaul.json` is a version 2 Bastion (13 October 2026, before the facilities overhaul). The other `bastion-pr*-sample.json` files are version 3 Bastions made while the facilities overhaul was built (each one shows what that pull request added). They are backup files, ready to Import on the test page (`tests/harness.html`).
- `bastion-v3-heavy.json` is the **heavy** version 3 Bastion for the Strip Back Overhaul (22 October 2026): all 13 facilities that are going (Barracks, Armoury, Watchtower, War Room, Menagerie, Library & Scriptorium, Arcane Laboratory, the three Shrines, Wyvern Roost, Griffin Tower, Dire Wolf Den) built or being built, 28 pending orders (at least one for each row of the conversion's table in `docs/strip-back/J-cross-cutting.md` section 4.3, with gold, Favour and held goods to refund), four beasts with their development, Trade Agreements, a Trade Consortium, sea routes, a dispute and Favour Tokens, a war against Clan Bacca, four regiments, two Menagerie beasts, armed defenders, Artisan Tools chosen, a founded Clan, a 200-line Day Log, a Great Rite, a held Blessing of Pelagos, Port Charters with a terms history, a ship at sea, a standing shipment, parcels, Diplomatic Records and the Explorer link's receipts. Every step of the conversion (`R.migrateToV4`, `tools/bastion/strip-back-rules.js`) is tested against it (`tests/rules/strip-back.test.js`, `tests/e2e/migration-v4.test.js`).
- `make-heavy.js` makes the heavy fixture and `bastion-fixtures.js`. Run it with Node (`node tests/fixtures/make-heavy.js`; no install needed). It uses the real data and rules, checks that loading the save keeps every field, and gives the same files every time. Change the Bastion's data shapes? Run it again and look at the difference.
- `bastion-fixtures.js` is **generated**: every `bastion-*.json` fixture as a script (`window.TSI_FIXTURES`), because the rules page (`tests/rules.html`) is opened as a file and cannot read `.json` files from disk. Add a new `bastion-*.json` fixture, run `make-heavy.js`, and the rules page has it.
- `demo-tool*` is the stand-in tool the test page (`tests/harness.html`) opens.
